name: It's Showtime
desc:
—Who witnessed his death?
—Me! I spied it with my little eyes!
—Who took his blood?
—Me! I seized it with my little saucer!
—Who dug his grave?
—Me! I did it with my chisel and shovel!
The sage schemes exhaustedly, the king lusts insatiably, the hero prides falsely — only the Fool laughs perpetually
"Now, let us welcome Ms. Sparkle to bring us the performance of the year — Penacony's Night of Fright!"

ability.name: Self-Amusement
ability.desc: When the wearer inflicts a debuff on an enemy, gains a stack of Trick. Every stack of Trick increases the wearer's DMG dealt by {0}%, stacking up to 3 time(s). This effect lasts for 1 turn(s). When the wearer's Effect Hit Rate is 80% or higher, increases ATK by {1}%.
